rules.forbids: forbids: adding to the crisis basket when all its channels are already traversed
rules.rule_text: late in a crisis the neglected side is resolution; when every channel is priced for continuation the unpriced asymmetry is de-escalation

rules.forbids: forbids: conditioning an offtake or force majeure call on which unit burned; forbids assuming a fuels-unit fire leaves the chemical side supplying
rules.rule_text: a fire in one unit of an integrated site stops deliveries of unrelated products; the offtaker's force majeure names the site, not the unit

rules.forbids: forbids: a falsifier that fires on commentary for a claim about prices; forbids reading a 'deepens congestion' headline as a price move
rules.rule_text: narrative and price diverge after a small shock: trade press narrates congestion the indices do not show; a price call must name the price series and nothing else in its falsifier

rules.forbids: forbids: remaining suppliers' spreads staying flat after a peer outage in a region-locked market
rules.rule_text: when one supplier of a region-locked product is removed, the remaining suppliers capture the spread

rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a large sustained equity loss for a diversified owner from one unit outage absent casualties or liability
rules.rule_text: the named victim of an event is over-attended relative to its earnings impact; single-unit losses at diversified owners are equity noise

rules.forbids: forbids: waiting for price prints to confirm a plant outage when a force majeure letter is available
rules.rule_text: a producer's force majeure declaration is the fastest public carrier of a plant outage, preceding every price print

rules.forbids: forbids: ignoring the co-product when scoping a plant outage
rules.rule_text: a plant that co-produces two products cuts both when it stops; the second product is named later than the first

rules.forbids: forbids: predicting feedstock tightening from a consumer outage
rules.rule_text: a large consumer of a feedstock going offline softens that feedstock at the margin

rules.forbids: forbids: long-rival/short-owner where the owner holds sister plants on the same node
rules.rule_text: the wounded owner of the substitutes collects its own scarcity premium; when the victim also owns remaining capacity the competitor's gift self-cancels

rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a stock move without comparing event earnings impact to concurrent macro variance on the same name
rules.rule_text: equity visibility equals event size divided by ambient tide; below a ratio to be measured there is no trace to trade

rules.forbids: forbids: the round-2 pre-lock prediction set
rules.rule_text: a plant outage in a region-locked concentrated product with an owner holding sister plants: force majeure arrives first, derivatives reprice larger than the parent, the co-product reprices only if its market is tight, and the owner's equity shows nothing

rules.forbids: forbids: assuming nameplate unit count, and therefore partial-site continuity, at an asset recently bought out of insolvency
rules.rule_text: a plant revived from insolvency runs fewer units than its nameplate; an outage there takes the whole site, not one unit

rules.forbids: forbids: expecting a force majeure letter as the fast public carrier for a contracted power plant; the notice goes to one counterparty and is not published
rules.rule_text: where offtake is a bilateral utility contract, the outage's first public carrier is the owner's quarterly disclosure, not a force majeure notice

rules.forbids: forbids: reading a null fuel-market response as evidence of slack when product loadings were already stopped for another reason
rules.rule_text: a pre-existing logistics stop masks an outage; when loadings are already halted the fuels market cannot see the unit go down

rules.forbids: forbids: scoring a commodity or equity leg as attributable when a larger concurrent driver set the price; forbids reading a null response under a tide as slack
rules.rule_text: a tide sets the price of everything it touches; an event under it is visible only in what the tide does not price

rules.forbids: forbids: predicting a public force majeure notice from an outage alone; forbids reading the absence of a notice as the absence of an outage
rules.rule_text: a producer issues a public force majeure when it has contracted offtake it cannot serve and a channel that reports it; a single-line unit in a thin-coverage market stops without a notice

rules.forbids: forbids: downstream derivative prices being unaffected by an upstream regional shutdown
rules.rule_text: when a large producing region is shut, its exports vanish and the chain downstream reprices in the order of substitution difficulty

rules.forbids: forbids: treating the commodity price as the earliest signal of a chokepoint or plant event
rules.rule_text: the toll booth learns before the cargo; constraint prices (insurance, freight, allocation) reprice before the commodity they gate

rules.forbids: forbids: a lasting operational or cost constraint on peer plants arising from a post-accident inspection order
rules.rule_text: a fatal industrial accident triggers a jurisdiction-wide inspection order within weeks that binds nothing durable on peers

rules.forbids: forbids: treating a chemical plant as unexposed to a refinery it is not co-located with; forbids assuming the link is priced before the notice
rules.rule_text: a single-supplier feedstock link is a hidden node; the downstream plant's force majeure is the first public statement of the link

evidence.title: First Alert 4 (KMOV), 12 Aug 2026: a closer look at the chemical and company behind the Sauget shelter-in-place
evidence.excerpt: Trichloroisocyanuric acid (TCCA) burned at the Container Port Group facility, which houses shipping containers at the Sauget location. The fire released chlorine gas. The EPA reported no violations at the site; Illinois regulators found no violations since 2013. Hundreds of residents sheltered in place on the East St. Louis district's third day of school; an all-clear followed. No company statement in the piece.

evidence.title: JOIFF incident report, Aug 2026: reactive chemical fire in Sauget triggers four-square-mile shelter-in-place
evidence.excerpt: Fire began about 12:45 a.m. on 12 August 2026 at ContainerPort Group, 2300 block of Sauget Industrial Parkway. Up to 15 pallets of trichloroisocyanuric acid were involved. The shelter-in-place covered roughly four square miles, from just north of St. Louis Downtown Airport to just south of State Street, affected more than 3,400 homes and businesses; more than 15 agencies were committed to containing the smoke plume. Lifted at 9 a.m. No injuries reported; cause under investigation.

evidence.title: KFVS12, 12 Aug 2026: shelter in place extended into East St. Louis, lifted 8:53 a.m.
evidence.excerpt: Fire reported just before 3 a.m. on Sauget Industrial Drive at ContainerPort Group St. Louis; the material is trichloroisocyanuric acid. The order was extended to part of East St. Louis north of Illinois Route 15 and lifted at 8:53 a.m. CDT. St. Clair County EMA's Herb Simmons: 'We've requested about five tandem loads of sand to put a berm up to isolate and mitigate water runoff.' East St. Louis District 189 closed all schools.

evidence.title: St. Louis Public Radio and FOX 2, 12 Aug 2026 (search summaries): order lifted; railroad operations shut down
evidence.excerpt: STLPR: the zone covered roughly four square miles from just north of the airport to just south of State Street and from South 19th Street east to just west of Interstate 255; District 189 closed all campuses. The search summary of the FOX 2 / STLPR coverage adds that 'railroad operations in the area were also shut down'; RiverBender puts the lift at 8:56 a.m. No road, river or airport closure is reported in any piece read; the FOX 2 page itself returned 403 to the fetcher.

evidence.title: Leslie's, Inc. Q3 fiscal 2026 results, released after the close on 12 Aug 2026
evidence.excerpt: Q3 sales $458.5m, down 8.4%; comparable sales down 6.2%; gross margin 36.5% vs 39.6%; adjusted EBITDA $55.7m vs $81.6m. Full-year outlook withdrawn: 'Given macroeconomic softness and the uncertainty around the company's ability to continue to drive consumer behavior.' Exploring 'a deleveraging transaction, potentially combined with one or more financing transactions'; liquidity $207.1m. No mention of a fire, Sauget, trichlor or chemical supply constraints.

evidence.title: Benzinga / Investing.com, 12-13 Aug 2026: Leslie's falls 44% after hours on the results and withdrawn guidance
evidence.excerpt: LESL plunged about 43% pre-open to $0.75 after results that missed on every metric (adjusted EPS $3.96 vs $5.06 consensus) and a withdrawn full-year outlook; lower traffic, unfavorable weather and promotional activity weighed; $786.7m long-term debt against $45.9m cash, strategic alternatives under way. None of the coverage connects the move to the Sauget fire.

evidence.title: GlobeNewswire, 5 Aug 2026: Leslie's to report third quarter 2026 results on 12 August 2026
evidence.excerpt: Leslie's announced on 5 August that it would release fiscal Q3 results after market close on Wednesday 12 August 2026 with a call at 5:00 p.m. ET. A forward-dated fact knowable a week before the event; it is carried by a press release (8-K item 7.01 or none), not by the item 2.02 filing the EDGAR reader looks for, and the IR events page had no Wayback snapshot.

evidence.title: Coverage record, 8 Sep 2026: pool trade press silent on Sauget; the 'chemical fire raises concerns' piece is the 2020 Westlake fire
evidence.excerpt: Pool & Spa News' only 'chemical fire raises concerns about trichlor supply' article is dated 23 Sep 2020 (BioLab Westlake, Louisiana). A site search for Sauget, ContainerPort or trichlor in 2026 returns nothing on the fire; searches for trichlor allocation, price or supply in August 2026 return only 2020-2025 shortage material. No producer, importer or distributor notice citing the fire was found.

evidence.title: Coverage record, 8 Sep 2026: USCG sector page, RiverBender and HazardEx unreadable to the fetcher; no NRC report number found
evidence.excerpt: The Coast Guard Sector Upper Mississippi River page, the RiverBender 'emergency director details decisions' article and the HazardEx piece returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher. Searches for a Coast Guard safety zone or marine safety bulletin at Sauget and for a National Response Center report for the fire found nothing; the NRC FOIA database was not searched directly. Ten local reports mention rail and schools but no river closure.

evidence.title: C&EN, 2021 (prior class): shortages of trichlor after the 2020 BioLab Westlake plant fire
evidence.excerpt: The recurring class: a domestic trichlor plant fire (BioLab Westlake, Aug 2020) removed one of three US producers and produced the 2021 tablet shortage, with prices up 37% year on year and forecast to reach 58%. A 2024 fire at a Georgia BioLab facility added fresh uncertainty into 2025. Sauget was a container yard holding 15 pallets, not a plant.

resolutions.scorer_note: A four-square-mile shelter-in-place over 3,400 homes and businesses in three communities, schools closed, rail operations shut: the shared space closed, not the asset. The toxic-release rule operated as written. Baseline (yard only) missed.

POOL +0.7pt vs XRT on 13 Aug, -2.5pt on 14 Aug, -0.7pt on 17 Aug. The 14 Aug slide is the Leslie's read-across; nothing cites the fire, so the falsifier (a >2% move with the fire cited) did not fire. Visibility ratio operated: 15 pallets against a $5bn distributor under a results tide. Baseline (rally on a supply scare) missed.

LESL -41.7% on 13 Aug and -16% on 14 Aug, entirely the results released after the 12 Aug close and the withdrawn outlook; no report cites the fire. No attributable move to the event, so the call holds, but the leg was swamped by its own tide: lib.tide_hides_event would have been the truer citation. Confound stated for the second scorer.
OXY -1.5pt vs XLE on 13 Aug, -0.3pt on 14 Aug, uncited and under the 2% line. Isocyanurates are invisible inside Occidental.

Branch corridor_closure arose. EMN +2.2pt vs XLB on 13 Aug is over the 2% line but nothing connects Eastman to Sauget, so the falsifier's second condition (closure cited) did not fire. An eight-hour shelter-in-place at a neighbouring plant is below visibility. Baseline (no move) also hit.

No force majeure, allocation or supply notice from any producer or importer in 14 days; the trade press is silent. Slack demonstrated by the retailer's own results (demand slump, promotions): a cut into a glut. Coverage thin: Pool & Spa News read through search and a site query only, ICIS unreachable.
No trichlor price move attributed to the fire anywhere in 14 days; the only 'chemical fire raises concerns' piece is the 2020 Westlake plant fire. Same slack basis. Coverage thin for the same reason.

Branch arose, but no Coast Guard safety zone or bulletin was found: ten local reports mention rail and schools and never the river, and the sector page was unreadable to the fetcher. Scored miss on the silence of the local press, coverage thin because the carrier itself was not read. No mechanism cited.
No NRC report number surfaced in any report and the NRC FOIA database was not searched directly; the filing may well exist. Unverified, not miss.

The cleanup factor is unverified (no report on the yard's status after 12 Aug); it is against, not binding, so the composite stands. The headline-names-what-reopened rule cannot be read either way: nothing reported on what stayed shut. Baseline (over within a day) also hit.

The channel did not say it: no pool trade press item on Sauget, and the local press framed it as a hazmat and school-closure story. Narrative row scored on whether the channel spoke, never on whether it was right.

The largest attributable move was physical: 3,400 homes indoors for eight hours, schools closed, rail stopped. No listed name moved attributably to the fire. The baseline 'the pool names move' was literally true (LESL -42%) for a reason that had nothing to do with the event, so it is scored hit and the edge on this row is nil.
HAYW -1.3% against LESL -50.8% over 13-19 Aug: the one trade won by 49 points on the retailer's results, not on the fire. A hit the event did not earn; the D6 row exists to show exactly this.
